title: NATIONAL CONSENSUS SURVEYS
instructions: Please take a few minutes to go through the advertisements in this book. Please take as much time with each ad as you care to. If you ordinarily wear reading glasses, you'll need them.
portfolio_instruction: HAND RESPONDENT PORTFOLIO AND TAKE IT BACK BEFORE CONTINUING

questions.text: Now, I'd like to ask you a few questions about the ads in the book. What brands or products do you remember seeing ads for in the book? (PLEASE:) Any other brands? (DO NOT READ EITHER BRAND NAMES OR PRODUCT CATEGORIES)

cigarette_questions.text: Do you remember any ads for cigarettes? Yes - What brands do you remember seeing ads for? Any others?
